viewer-demo-journey.name: Complete base desktop weather viewer journey
viewer-demo-journey.description: The public user completes the original Phase 08 wind, temperature, airport, timeline, playback, reset, and deterministic reload journey.

viewer-airport-intelligence.name: Search an airport and explore its six-point trend
viewer-airport-intelligence.description: The user searches SKBO by its public identity, focuses it without opening the picker, reads its six simulated points, and selects 09Z from the trend.

viewer-weather-picker.name: Inspect local weather at a map coordinate
viewer-weather-picker.description: A background map click places or moves one picker and displays temperature, wind speed, direction, coordinate, and active UTC from the same local grids.

viewer-route-story.name: Build and inspect an airport route wind story
viewer-route-story.description: The user creates SKBO to SKRG, sees one map route and its simulated distance, head/tail/crosswind profile and permanent planning disclaimer.

viewer-atmospheric-layers.name: Switch to precipitation with an independent isobar overlay
viewer-atmospheric-layers.description: The user selects precipitation as the only primary layer, enables isobars independently, and sees the precipitation legend and synchronized overlay.

viewer-scene-sharing.name: Copy and restore a canonical enriched scene
viewer-scene-sharing.description: The user copies the canonical scene URL, opens it, and restores viewport, layer, timestamp, airport, picker, route, isobars, and presentation-safe state.

viewer-presentation-mode.name: Enter and exit the internal presentation mode
viewer-presentation-mode.description: The user contracts secondary controls while preserving brand, UTC, layer, legend, timeline, warning, active map results, and the visible exit action.

viewer-enriched-reset.name: Reset the complete enriched viewer scene
viewer-enriched-reset.description: After airport, picker, route, precipitation, isobars, viewport, playback, URL, and presentation changes, reset returns once to wind 06Z and the canonical empty scene.

viewer-catalog-recovery.name: Recover from an unavailable weather catalog
viewer-catalog-recovery.description: The shell and map remain visible while the user retries a failed frozen catalog.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: directed orchestrator tests cover catalog failure and retry; Phase 14 authorizes only the two commercial journeys for new E2E coverage.

viewer-airports-recovery.name: Recover airports without blocking weather
viewer-airports-recovery.description: Weather remains usable while the user retries unavailable airport GeoJSON.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: independent failure and retry are covered by directed orchestrator tests and the stability rehearsal.

viewer-frame-recovery.name: Preserve and retry a failed atomic frame
viewer-frame-recovery.description: A required main, airport, picker, or route product failure preserves the previous complete timestamp and exposes recovery.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: product failures, race discard, abort, preservation, and retry have directed ViewerOrchestrator coverage.

viewer-wind-fallback.name: Continue with static wind arrows
viewer-wind-fallback.description: A particle renderer failure announces and retains the original static-arrow fallback.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: renderer and orchestrator tests plus the required fallback rehearsal cover this outcome.

viewer-map-recovery.name: Explain and retry map initialization failure
viewer-map-recovery.description: MapLibre or WebGL2 failure keeps the warning and exposes an honest retry state when possible.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: shell and controller tests cover retryable and non-retryable map states.

viewer-search-validation.name: Explain an airport search with no demo result
viewer-search-validation.description: A user-entered query outside the six frozen airports shows a no-results message without changing the scene.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: AirportSearch keyboard, empty-result, and selection behavior is covered in its directed component tests.

viewer-trend-recovery.name: Retry an unavailable airport trend
viewer-trend-recovery.description: The active airport remains selected while the user retries a failed six-point evolution request.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: the trend hook and AirportTrend component cover failure, retry, race, cache, and unmount cleanup.

viewer-picker-recovery.name: Distinguish picker outside coverage and unavailable data
viewer-picker-recovery.description: The picker preserves its marker and distinguishes coverage rejection from a same-timestamp product failure with retry.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: picker service, sampler, component, and orchestrator tests cover both negative classes.

viewer-route-validation.name: Reject, invert, retry, and clear route inputs
viewer-route-validation.description: The route form rejects equal endpoints and lets the user invert, retry, or clear controlled selections.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: RoutePlanner and route analysis directed tests cover invalid, inverse, retry, and clear behavior.

viewer-isobar-recovery.name: Hide failed isobars without aborting the primary frame
viewer-isobar-recovery.description: An isobar load failure hides only the overlay, explains the issue, and leaves layer, timestamp, UTC, and legend committed.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: the optional-overlay outcome is covered atomically in ViewerOrchestrator and adapter tests.

viewer-scene-normalization.name: Normalize a partial or invalid viewer URL
viewer-scene-normalization.description: Opening an invalid or partial query safely uses defaults, omits invalid selections, and replaces it with the canonical URL.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: codec boundary matrices, URL synchronizer tests, and complete-scene orchestrator bootstrap cover validation and canonicalization.

viewer-share-fallback.name: Fall back to manual scene URL copy
viewer-share-fallback.description: Clipboard denial exposes a focused read-only URL for manual copy without losing the scene.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: SceneShare directed tests cover absent, rejected, stale, and successful Clipboard outcomes.

viewer-presentation-fallback.name: Keep internal presentation mode without Fullscreen
viewer-presentation-fallback.description: Fullscreen denial is explained while the internal mode and its exit remain usable.
knownGaps: Intentional E2E exemption: PresentationMode tests cover unavailable Fullscreen, keyboard exclusions, repeated requests, and cleanup.
